com.flyio.graphql#operation.query:
query addOn($id: ID, $name: String, $provider: String) {
  addOn(id: $id, name: $name, provider: $provider) {
    id
    name
    primaryRegion
    readRegions
    status
    errorMessage
    publicUrl
    privateIp
    password
    ssoLink
    environment
    options
    metadata
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    addOnPlan {
      id
      name
      displayName
      description
      maxDataSize
      pricePerMonth
    }
    addOnPlanName
    addOnProvider {
      id
      name
      displayName
      tosUrl
      tosAgreement
      asyncProvisioning
      autoProvision
      beta
      internal
      selectName
      selectRegion
      selectReplicaRegions
      detectPlatform
      resourceName
      nameSuffix
      provisioningInstructions
    }
    organization {
      id
      name
      slug
      rawSlug
      paidPlan
      billable
      provisionsBetaExtensions
    }
    app {
      id
      name
    }
  }
}
